title: Hamiltonian Fixed Points Below the Stable Morse Number

abstractEnglish: We disprove the stable Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points by constructing a simply connected closed Kähler manifold with sixteen fewer fixed points than its stable Morse number. All the corresponding periodic orbits are contractible. The construction combines a Hamiltonian involution with integral homology torsion at two different primes; its proof uses finite-dimensional Morse theory and complex blowups.
titleEn: Hamiltonian Fixed Points Below the Stable Morse Number

details.overview: 稿件研究非退化Hamiltonian不动点数的下界问题。作者声称构造了一个单连通闭Kähler流形，其非退化Hamiltonian不动点比稳定Morse数少十六个，从而否证稳定Morse下界；相应周期轨道均为可缩的。构造结合了一个Hamiltonian对合与两个不同素数处的整同调挠，证明使用有限维Morse理论与复爆破。该结果对Hamiltonian动力系统中的不动点计数下界提出反例。
